sentences.en: Algeria needs to encourage the use of proper irrigation techniques.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要鼓励使用正确的灌溉技术。

sentences.en: Deforestation and poor irrigation practices can lead to irreversible desertification.
sentences.zh: 滥伐森林和不合理的灌溉方式可能导致不可逆转的土地沙漠化。

sentences.en: Sami's body was found in the irrigation canal.
sentences.zh: 萨米的身体被发现灌溉沟渠中。

senses.zh: 灌溉,水利,医冲洗,冲注洗剂
